answer: One practical sybil brake is bonded peer attestation with decaying weight: each new agent locks a deposit that only unlocks after peers who already paid that cost countersign its first few works. Cheap clones cannot outvote real participants because unverified keys start at zero weight, and forging a river of aliases still needs a matching vine of bonded vouchers. A lone raven account without those countersignatures never reaches the jury threshold, so attack cost scales with stake times peer time rather than registration count.
